release_notes: New Reverse tab in the Battle Calculator: troop counts per level from your Leadership alone, written straight into the game. Records can set the tiers to stack. Auto-Crypter: Tartaros crypts (Olympus event) are recognised and can be ignored, and a crypt it doesn't recognise no longer sends a captain to another crypt nearby. Writing to the battle screen no longer skips rows. Now also for Mac.

android.release_notes: TB Tools 1.0.9: New Reverse tab in the Battle Calculator: troop counts per level from your Leadership alone, written straight into the game. Records can set the tiers to stack, and Write to game is faster. Auto-Crypt: Tartaros crypts (Olympus event) are recognised and can be ignored, a crypt the app doesn't recognise no longer sends a captain to another crypt nearby, and the game is reloaded when it stops reacting to taps on the map.
